description: This file defines the SnapshotStorage class, which manages frame snapshots, resource snapshots, and rendering for trace analysis in a web automation context. It includes methods for adding resources, frame snapshots, retrieving snapshots by name, finalizing resource sorting, and checking resource overrides.

classes.name: SnapshotStorage
classes.description: Manages storage and retrieval of frame and resource snapshots, including resource override handling and snapshot finalization.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource snapshot to a specific context, rewriting its URL for custom protocols.

methods.name: addFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Adds a frame snapshot to the storage, creating a renderer for it, and handling resource overrides.

methods.name: snapshotByName
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot renderer by its name within a given page or frame ID.

methods.name: snapshotsForTest
methods.description: Returns all stored frame snapshot keys for testing purposes.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Sorts resources by monotonic time and records URLs with resource overrides to prevent caching issues.

methods.name: hasResourceOverride
methods.description: Checks if a resource URL has an override present.

methods.name: _ensureResourcesForContext
methods.description: Ensures and retrieves the resource list for a given context ID, creating it if necessary.
